load_classification_dataset: load a classification dataset from TensorFlow Datasets using dataset info and split name
load_regression_dataset: load a regression dataset and return train and test data with standardized features
config_from_dataset_name: create a testbed problem config from a dataset name with configurable tau, seed, and noise parameters
get_uci_data: get features and labels arrays from a UCI dataset CSV file by name
standardize_data: standardize input data by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
